官方资料核验于 2026 年 9 月 26 日。路线顺序与时长为 BAYLINK: Official sources checked September 26, 2026. Route order and durations are BAYLINK editorial suggestions; recheck opening, prices, reservations, construction and transport before leaving.
Mountain View 科技半日：计算机历史馆与可选湖边散步: A technology half day in Mountain View: computer history and an optional lakeside walk
先读懂一段计算史，Shoreline 另留交通和步行时间: Explore computing history, then allow separate travel and walking time for Shoreline
从早期计算工具走到软件故事，把演示排期、门票、无障碍与湖边加选拆开安排。: Move from early calculating devices to software stories, planning demos, tickets, accessibility and the optional lake visit separately.
查开放与主要展览，门票从官方入口进入。: Check opening and major exhibits, and buy tickets through the official site.
了解从早期计算到现代电脑的展览主题。: Explore exhibition themes from early calculation to modern computers.
查停车、轮椅、包袋与参观准备。: Check parking, wheelchairs, bags and visit preparation.
机器演示有独立排期，不代表每日都有。: Machine demonstrations have their own schedule and do not necessarily run every day.
核对湖边设施与户外规则，作为独立加选目的地。: Check lakeside amenities and outdoor rules for this optional separate destination.
Computer History Museum 适合带着日常问题来逛：购物、工作: Visit the Computer History Museum with an everyday question: how did shopping, work and friendship become computerized? Revolution combines devices with human stories, making it approachable without a technical background. Give the museum the main half day, adding Shoreline Lake only if weather, energy and transport suit your group.
用主题选展，不用逐件看完: Choose a theme instead of seeing every object
费用：展览需门票，商店和咖啡馆消费另算；优惠资格、儿童票与演示安排查当天官网。: Cost: exhibits require admission; store and cafe purchases are separate. Check current discounts, child tickets and demonstration arrangements online.
时长：馆内建议 2.5–4 小时；加湖边需另算转场和散步，不把两地当成一座连续园: Duration: allow 2.5–4 hours inside. The lake requires additional travel and walking time; these are separate destinations.
到达：导航 1401 N Shoreline Blvd；馆方列有免费停车。从 M: Arrival: navigate to 1401 N Shoreline Blvd; the museum lists free parking. From Mountain View station, plan the remaining bus, bike or pickup connection.
行动需求：馆方说明展览可供轮椅通行，借用轮椅数量有限；大包进入展厅的规则提前确认: Mobility: exhibits are wheelchair accessible and loan wheelchairs are limited. Check the rules for large bags before entering galleries.
馆内两段，再决定是否去湖边: Two museum stops, then decide on the lake
计算工具、软件与湖边加选: Calculating devices, software and an optional lake visit
前两站都在计算机历史馆，第三站是需另行安排交通的公园。: The first two stops are inside the Computer History Museum; the third is a park requiring separate travel arrangements.
先在入口取图并看当天演示表，再从计算工具或早期机器选择一个主题。带孩子可以比较设: Pick up a map and check the demo schedule, then choose a theme among calculating devices or early machines. Children can compare size, input methods and purpose, asking whose problem each machine solved. Adults can read selected cases in depth; agree on a meeting point with your companions.
第二站：软件展或当日机器演示: Stop 2: software or a scheduled machine demonstration
第二段选择软件主题，或参加已经核实排期的机器演示；演示不是随到随开的项目。看完一: Choose software exhibits or a machine demonstration whose schedule you have confirmed. Demos do not run on demand. Take a break and compare the devices with your phone. If the schedule does not work, continue exploring independently instead of squeezing the rest of your visit around a wait.
第三站：Shoreline Lake 可选短走: Stop 3: an optional short walk at Shoreline Lake
离馆前先检查湖边天气和到达路线，再安排到 Shoreline Lake 的独立交: Before leaving the museum, check lake weather and directions and arrange the separate trip to Shoreline Lake. The park entrance is not the lakeside. Walk a short out-and-back section suited to your energy and observe birds without feeding them. Skip the lake in strong wind, heat or fading daylight.
给不同年龄和天气留出选择: Leave options for different ages and weather
学龄孩子可用“找一件比自己大、比自己老的机器”开始，幼儿则适合短看与多休息，不把: School-age children can start by finding a machine bigger or older than themselves. Younger children benefit from short sessions and breaks. Keep the museum route on rainy days; bring sun protection and a layer for the lake on clear days. Plan your return from whichever destination you finish at, confirming transit connections rather than assuming an easy pickup.
核对参观日期、门票和闭馆公告。: Check your visit date, tickets and closure notices.
想看机器运行时，单独确认演示排期。: Confirm the demo schedule separately if you want to see machines operating.
需要轮椅或其他协助，提前联系前台。: Contact the front desk in advance for wheelchairs or other assistance.
加湖边前保存独立导航和返程方式。: Save separate lake directions and a return plan before adding the stop.
打开 CHM 官方参观规划: Open the official CHM visit planner
核对展览、门票与导览，再决定当天重点。: Check exhibits, tickets and tours before choosing your day's focus.
继续安排湾区半日游: Plan another Bay Area half day
按所在地区选择下一站，把交通和休息一起放进行程。: Choose your next stop by region, allowing time for transport and breaks.
